config.displayMode.description: Display mode: 'api' for pay-per-use (today/month), 'subscription' for fixed plan (5h/7d utilization %)
config.displayMode.enumDescription.api: Pay-per-use mode: shows today's and this month's costs
config.displayMode.enumDescription.subsc: Fixed subscription mode: shows 5-hour and 7-day utilization percentages
config.refreshIntervalSeconds.descriptio: Data refresh interval for the status bar (seconds). In subscription mode, setting this too low may cause rate limit errors (429). 300 seconds or more is recommended.
config.statusBarPriority.description: Status bar display priority (higher value = further from center; more right for right alignment, more left for left alignment)
config.ccusagePath.description: Path to the ccusage binary. Leave empty to search PATH (requires: npm install -g ccusage).
